title: You Said 'Broadly', Didn't You
gist_ar: استجواب في محكمة. الأسئلة قصيرة ومترابطة، والفخ في كلمة واحدة.

before_listening.en: A cross-examination. Short questions building on each other, and the whole thing turns on one word in an earlier answer.
before_listening.ar: استجواب في المحكمة. أسئلة قصيرة بتبني على بعضها، والقضية كلها بتتحدّد بكلمة واحدة.

segments.speaker: Counsel
segments.text: Mr Rashad, before the break you told my learned friend that the inspection regime was, and I wrote it down, 'broadly compliant'. Do you stand by that?

segments.speaker: Mr Rashad
segments.text: I do.

segments.speaker: Counsel
segments.text: Would you help me with 'broadly'? Is that a term of art in your industry, or is it a word you chose this morning?

segments.speaker: Mr Rashad
segments.text: It's — it isn't a defined term, no. It's a fair summary.

segments.speaker: Counsel
segments.text: A fair summary of what proportion? Half? Nine tenths?

segments.speaker: Mr Rashad
segments.text: I couldn't put a figure on it standing here.

segments.speaker: Counsel
segments.text: No. But somebody did, didn't they. Bundle four, tab nineteen. That's your own internal quarterly, your name at the top. What figure does it give for completed inspections against schedule?

segments.speaker: Mr Rashad
segments.text: ...Sixty-one per cent.

segments.speaker: Counsel
segments.text: Sixty-one. Is sixty-one 'broadly'?

segments.speaker: Mr Rashad
segments.text: In the context of a regime that was being rebuilt at the time, I'd say it—

segments.speaker: Counsel
segments.text: I'll come to the rebuilding. My question was whether sixty-one per cent is 'broadly compliant'.

segments.speaker: Mr Rashad
segments.text: On its own, no, I wouldn't describe sixty-one as broadly.

segments.speaker: Counsel
segments.text: Thank you. Now the rebuilding, since you raise it. The regime was being rebuilt because of the 2019 findings.

segments.speaker: Mr Rashad
segments.text: Partly, yes.

segments.speaker: Counsel
segments.text: And the 2019 findings concerned the same three sites we are concerned with today.

segments.speaker: Mr Rashad
segments.text: Two of the three.

segments.speaker: Counsel
segments.text: Two of the three. I'm grateful — that's a correction I'll accept. Which two?

segments.speaker: Mr Rashad
segments.text: Harrow Bank and the Quay.

segments.speaker: Counsel
segments.text: So by the time of this quarterly, you knew that two of these three sites had been the subject of adverse findings four years earlier, you knew your own completion rate stood at sixty-one per cent, and the word you selected for the board was 'broadly'. That's right, isn't it?

segments.speaker: Mr Rashad
segments.text: The word I selected was — yes. I wrote that word. I'd say in fairness the table was in the same document, two pages later.

segments.speaker: Counsel
segments.text: It was. Two pages later, in nine-point type, in an appendix. And the board minute for that meeting records what, on the inspection regime?

segments.speaker: Mr Rashad
segments.text: ...'Noted as broadly compliant.'

segments.speaker: Counsel
segments.text: Your word, in their minute. Nothing further, my lord.

gist_question.q: What does counsel establish through the questioning?
options: That the witness fabricated the sixty-one per cent figure
That the word 'broadly' carried a figure the witness himself would not call broad, and the board adopted it
That the 2019 findings were never communicated to him
That the inspections at Harrow Bank were never carried out

questions.q: What figure did the internal quarterly give for inspections completed against schedule?
options: Nineteen per cent
Sixty-one per cent
Ninety per cent
Fifty per cent

questions.q: How many of the three sites were covered by the 2019 findings?
options: All three
One
Two — Harrow Bank and the Quay
None of them

questions.q: Why does counsel press on whether 'broadly' is a term of art?
options: To show he had copied it from the 2019 report
To demonstrate he misunderstood the question
Because the term is defined in the bundle
To establish it was the witness's own chosen word, not an industry standard

questions.q: What is the significance of the board minute at the end?
options: It shows the board disagreed with the witness's assessment
It proves the appendix was never circulated
It records the witness's own word as the board's finding
It contains a different figure from the quarterly

questions.q: How does counsel treat the witness's correction about 'two of the three'?
options: She disputes it and returns to it later
She accepts it openly and then uses it in her final question
She asks the judge to strike it from the record
She ignores it entirely
